visual.general_description: Twelve-lead ECG printout on pink grid paper with lead labels and three blue arrows.

Printed lead labels include aVR, V1 and V4 on the top row, aVL, V2 and V5 on the second row, and I, aVF, V3 and V6 on the third row; a fourth long strip runs along the bottom. No patient name or calendar date is printed.
